comment: session.create {title: "Bot Chat", hidden: true} result, methods_session.py:128-160. The response shape is identical to an ordinary create — `hidden` is deferred intent stored as pending_hidden (:101), not something the result echoes — so the only proof the flag travelled is the REQUEST, which is what the encoding test asserts. Nothing is on disk yet either: the create deliberately persists no DB row (:114-119); the row materialises on the first prompt.submit and set_session_hidden applies the pending flag then (server.py:3206-3226). stored_session_id is the durable key to pin; session_id is the ephemeral runtime id prompt.submit takes.
